## Bio

I am a fourth-year honors psychology student with a minor in data science. I previously completed my honors thesis on the preserved proactive suppression of salient distractors in aging in the Attention and Performance Lab at OSU. Through my time working on this project, I became increasingly interested in how physiological measures can reveal the timing and mechanics of cognitive and emotional processes.

My time in the BEAVERS Lab has allowed me to pursue this interest further in a clinical context. Outside the lab, I volunteer in addiction recovery and conduct behavioral health research at OSU Extension. After completing my degree, I plan to pursue a PhD in Clinical Psychology.
